File a suit for khula (dissolution of marriage) in the appropriate Family Court, invoking Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 Section 8.
Participate in the court‑ordered reconciliation or mediation process; if it fails, the court will issue a decree for dissolution.
Be prepared to surrender up to 50% of deferred dower or 25% of prompt dower as the court may order, and negotiate any financial settlement accordingly.
